programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

programme.title: Lawrence of Arabia
programme.desc: Epic dramatisation of T E Lawrence's life and his efforts to unite the Arabs against the Turkish Empire in World War I. The film tells the story of the young desk soldier in Cairo, frustrated by lack of opportunity, who is finally given the chance to prove himself. Lawrence's complex personality is explored against a backdrop of stunning desert scenery and riveting action.

programme.title: Live: WA Ultimate Championship
programme.desc: Live coverage from Budapest of day 2 of the inaugural edition of the World Athletics Ultimate Championship.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: The team are in Aberystwyth at the Old College, the original site of the first university in Wales. The experts on duty are David Harper and Christina Trevanion. Christina values a Victorian Claret jug and David gets all of a flutter over a large selection of antique fans. Meanwhile, Paul Martin visits Laugharne, the home of his literary hero, Dylan Thomas.

programme.title: Grand Tours of Scotland's Lochs
programme.desc: Paul visits Wester Ross and discovers the heritage of Little Loch Broom. He then travels to the off-grid community of Scoraig where he learns about violin making and wind power, before taking the plunge to explore the hidden depths of the Corrieshalloch Gorge.

programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.desc: Katie Derham and Nick Mohammed lead the celebrations live from the Royal Albert Hall as the biggest party in classical music gets under way. Superstar pianist Yuja Wang and operatic sensation Nicky Spence top the bill as Sakari Oramo conducts the BBC Symphony Orchestra and Chorus, and the BBC Singers. Highlights include Bernstein's sparkling Overture to Candide, Barber's Piano Concerto and Smetana's epic Má vlast.

programme.title: Radio 2 in the Park
programme.desc: Highlights from a packed first day of incredible music at Radio 2 in the Park in Stirling, featuring standout performances from Texas, Lulu, Jack Savoretti, ABC, The Script and Emeli Sandé as a spectacular day of live music is celebrated in Scotland.

programme.title: Radio 2 in the Park
programme.desc: The 'queen of funk', Chaka Khan, headlines the first day of Radio 2 in the Park live from Stirling, bringing her powerhouse vocals, legendary hits and five decades' worth of soul and funk to the stage. Join the global superstar for an unforgettable headline performance packed with classic songs, incredible energy and the unmistakable voice that has made her a music icon.

programme.title: Chaka Khan at the BBC
programme.desc: This selection of Chaka's finest BBC moments covers five decades of performing, reflecting a career that started in the 70s with her partnership with Rufus and eventually led to the massive number one hit 'I Feel for You', which helped bring rap right into the mainstream, and 'I'm Every Woman', an instant anthem that made her a lifelong female icon.

programme.title: Texas at the BBC
programme.desc: Sharleen Spiteri takes a dive into the BBC's music archives for a look back at some of Texas' greatest appearances on a selection of programmes and live events from across their career.

programme.title: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Day 4 highlights from the third Test match between England and Pakistan at Edgbaston.

programme.title: Saint Omer
programme.desc: Rama is a novelist who attends the trial of Laurence Coly, a young woman accused of killing her 15-month-old daughter. Testimonies from witnesses and Coly's own words soon shake Rama's convictions.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: John Craven and Anita Rani are in Cumbria to see how arable farmers more used to rain than drought have fared after a record-breaking dry summer.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The BBC's Breakfast programme features the latest news, sport, business, weather and other items on a daily basis.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek follows the river Taff to Breacon, stands on Devil's Bridge in Pontarfynach and takes the steam train around Barmouth Bay when he revisits his most-loved waterways walks.

programme.title: Beechgrove Garden
programme.desc: Brian Cunningham launches an experiment, and Ruth Vichos looks back at two of the projects she has been overseeing this summer.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt shares an abundance of autumnal recipes from the Saturday Kitchen archives, including dishes from Elliott Grover, Theo Randall and Tony Singh.

programme.title: Caribbean Food Made Easy
programme.desc: Levi tempts shoppers in Glasgow with an aromatic pineapple dessert, takes to the seas to show Mull fishermen how to dub up their catch, and lays on the ultimate Caribbean cricket tea for two teams of hungry Yorkshire men.

programme.title: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook
programme.desc: Lorraine Pascale helps Sonia Harwood, a mother-of-three and foster carer who would love to create homemade family meals but ends up relying on frozen food. Lorraine shows her how easy cooking with fresh ingredients can be, demonstrating recipes including courgette fritters and a quick seafood linguine.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: The reds and blues are bargain hunting at the Mona Showground on the Isle of Anglesey in north Wales. Anita Manning is overseeing proceedings, and experts Danny Sebastian and Nick Hall help the teams invest their £300 wisely.

programme.title: The Big Deal
programme.desc: Two teams of aspiring art dealers are tasked with curating artwork for a luxury cruise ship in the semi-final. One team secures a lucrative deal, one pair faces elimination.

programme.title: Live: WSL
programme.desc: Coverage of the clash between Arsenal and Crystal Palace in the Women's Super League.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin is at Ashridge House, where experts Thomas Plant and Claire Rawle are on hand to give advice. Among the items that go to auction is a splendid microscope.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Eagles are the most powerful birds in the sky. They are capable of tackling enormous prey, spotting food at vast distances and soaring for miles on the wing. Follow the story of a family of bald eagles, as bird specialist Lloyd Buck puts his trained golden eagle to the test in a series of remarkable experiments.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Joe Crowley, Datshiane Navanayagam and Adam Henson head to Westacre Estate in Norfolk to discover how a historic rural estate is adapting to survive in the modern world.

programme.title: Pilgrimage
programme.desc: The celebrities finish their journey at Einsiedeln Abbey, a pilgrim destination for over 1,000 years. They witness a lively cattle show in Urnasch, and learn about the Jewish heritage of two Swiss villages.

programme.title: Rob and Rylan's Passage to India
programme.desc: Rob and Rylan are on the final leg of their Indian adventure. They discover an erotic temple, try mud wrestling for spiritual growth and go barefoot through Varanasi, India's holiest city.

programme.title: Radio 2 in the Park
programme.desc: Local heroes Simple Minds headline the final day of Radio 2 in the Park from Stirling, bringing their iconic anthems, decades of hits and electrifying live show to an unforgettable festival finale.

programme.title: Radio 2 in the Park
programme.desc: Highlights from a packed final day of incredible music at Radio 2 in the Park in Stirling, featuring standout performances from Deacon Blue, Appleton, Blue, Cast, James Blunt and Level 42 for a spectacular day of live music in Scotland.

programme.title: Solheim Cup Women's Golf
programme.desc: Highlights from the third and final day of the 2026 Solheim Cup at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands.

programme.title: Today at the Test
programme.desc: Coverage of the 2026 Test series between England and Pakistan.

programme.title: Colin from Accounts
programme.desc: Gordon and Ashley are determined to move on from the embarrassment of Gordon's ill-fated proposal at Megan and Rumi's pop-up wedding. But a chance encounter at a suburban GP clinic throws their plans for forward momentum off course.

programme.title: Colin from Accounts
programme.desc: Ash reunites with Colin, and Gordon invites her - along with her eager boyfriend, David - to his birthday party at Echo Park Brewery, which is being thrown by his new girlfriend, Chelsea.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a mayday comes in from a yacht breaking up off the Norfolk coast, both the Great Yarmouth and Gorleston RNLI crew and Caister's independent lifeboats race to the rescue.

programme.title: This Is BBC TWO
programme.desc: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

programme.title: Money for Nothing
programme.desc: Jacqui Joseph is on patrol at Altrincham Recycling Centre, hoping to uncover three lucrative items amongst the skip-bound rubbish. Uzo shifts gears to turn car seat leather into stylish bags. Will it be a smooth ride, or will he stall at the start line? Upcycler Hannah's challenge is to breathe new life into two tired pieces of well-worn furniture - but will the results produce profits?

programme.title: Celebrity MasterChef
programme.desc: After three weeks of intense competition, the heats are over and only the best nine cooks remain. Now, it's the first of the semi-finals and the celebrities will be tested on their teamwork with their toughest challenge so far. Split into three teams, the celebrities venture outside the MasterChef kitchen for the first time for a tough challenge.

programme.title: Match of the Day
programme.desc: Highlights of two Premier League matches, including the Manchester derby from Old Trafford. Michael Carrick made a dream start as Manchester United head coach with a 2-0 win over Manchester City in his first game in charge back in January. In the other game, newly promoted Coventry welcome Brighton to the CBS Arena. Frank Lampard's team, who are back in the Premier League for the first time in 25 years, lost their first home game of the season against fellow new boys Hull.

programme.title: BBC News
programme.desc: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

programme.title: Politics Live
programme.desc: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

programme.title: Impossible
programme.desc: Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.

programme.title: The Edge
programme.desc: The game show that mixes general knowledge quizzing and bowling.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Jason Manford hosts the quiz show where players face a question and pick from a board of six rankable answers. Some answers are good, but only one is unbeatable.

programme.title: Great British Railway Journeys
programme.desc: Michael Portillo experiences a terrifying 'victory roll' in a World War II Spitfire, high above the most famous aerodrome of the Battle of Britain, Biggin Hill. The 80-year-old aircraft, in which so many young men risked their lives for the nation, is one of a fleet intensively maintained by a dedicated team of technicians, and Michael is privileged to be flown by an ex-Royal Navy pilot.

programme.title: Eva Longoria: Searching for Mexico
programme.desc: Eva Longoria visits the state of Jalisco, where much of what is seen is quintessentially 'Mexican' originated. She also discovers that the state capital, Guadalajara, boasts some of the country's most cutting-edge restaurants.

programme.title: Wild China
programme.desc: The fairytale hills of Guilin and the cormorant fishermen of the Li River form the heart of this exploration of the colourful rice-growing cultures and strange creatures of southern China - a land of endless hills, mysterious caverns, spectacular rock pinnacles and traditional cultures with a taste for wildlife.
